Each string in the "pages" list is one page. Use \n for line breaks.

The book opens on a double page: page 1 on the left, page 2 on the right.

You can change the cover in this same file:

"color": the cover and the spine on the shelf
"accent": frame, symbol and spine bands
"textColor": the title
"symbol": diamond, circle, cross, moon, eye or none
"image": a picture such as images/my-cover.png (replaces the symbol)
Add as many pages as you want.
